reader_note: The value covers all five committee pages (chairs, members, independence, financial literacy, audit committee financial experts, Rule 16b-3 and interlock status), four committee-report signatures, the 13-nominee count, the independence determination naming 13 independent directors, Bourla as combined Chairman/CEO, Narayen as Lead Independent Director, the 2024 elections of Buckley and Taraporevala, Hobbs's April 2025 retirement and Desmond-Hellmann's succession as Science and Technology Chair; every selected block states a fact, nine of them mixed with process, policy or rationale. Notable: the nominee summary table and all 13 director cards ('Board Committees:', 'Chairman and CEO', 'Lead Independent Director') are pool, as are the election and committee-refreshment paragraphs (459, 1030, 1129) and the leadership sentence in the Governance Committee report (1127), but every fact they state is also in a selected block; the table's text loses its column alignment (marks run together as 'ü2017ll2', some rows' marks are absent), and Taraporevala's start is dated July in the Lead Independent Director's letter (193) but June in 459/1000/1288 and June 27 in 1335.
